description: This file defines a set of template classes and utilities for proxy objects, reference counting, object management, and thread-safe collections such as lists, queues, and maps within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes classes for proxy object management, reference counting, container wrappers, and synchronization primitives, tailored for efficient and safe object handling in a multi-threaded environment.

classes.name: ProxyObject
classes.description: A final class template that manages an object of type CONTEXT with reference counting and custom memory allocation, supporting thread-safe reference management and object lifecycle control.

classes.name: ProxyType
classes.description: A template class that acts as a smart pointer for reference-counted objects, supporting creation, assignment, and type conversions, ensuring proper reference management.

classes.name: ProxyList
classes.description: A template class implementing a thread-unsafe dynamic list of reference-counted objects, with automatic resizing and element management.

classes.name: ProxyQueue
classes.description: A class template implementing a thread-safe producer-consumer queue with support for blocking insertions and extractions, using internal state management.

classes.name: ProxyMapType
classes.description: A thread-safe map container associating keys with proxy objects, supporting lookup, insertion, removal, and iteration with callback support.

classes.name: ProxyContainerType
classes.description: A wrapper class for container objects that manages lifecycle, initialization, and notification, supporting parent-child relationships.

classes.name: UnlinkStorage
classes.description: A utility class encapsulating a callback function for unlinking or cleanup actions, used in container management.

methods.name: Myself
methods.description: A private method in ProxyObject that loads the object into a ProxyType.

methods.name: CreateMove
methods.description: A static method in ProxyType that creates an object and moves it into a provided ProxyType instance.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: A static method in ProxyType that creates and returns a new proxy object with given constructor arguments.

methods.name: CreateEx
methods.description: A static method in ProxyType that creates and returns a new proxy object with additional size and constructor arguments.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a ProxyObject into a ProxyType, increasing reference count.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal references of ProxyType.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Notifies the parent container about changes in the proxy object.
